nodes.summary: For a graph $G$ write $\alpha(G)$ for its independence number and $e(G)$ for its number of edges, and call $G$ $K_4$-free if it has no four pairwise adjacent vertices. The statement is the conjunction of the following four assertions.
nodes.title: Ramsey–Turán problem for $K_4$ (Erdős Problem 22)

nodes.summary: For a graph $G$ write $\alpha(G)$ for its independence number and $e(G)$ for its number of edges, and call $G$ $K_4$-free if it has no four pairwise adjacent vertices. All four of the following assertions hold.
nodes.title: Resolution of Erdős Problem 22 (Fox–Loh–Zhao)

nodes.summary: There is a real $\delta > 0$ such that for every real $c > 0$ there are infinitely many $n$ for which some $K_5$-free simple graph on $n$ vertices has at least $\delta n^2$ edges and yet has no triangle-free set of at least $c n$ vertices (a set of vertices no three of which are pairwise adjacent). In other words, the EP-533 conjecture fails.
nodes.title: EP-533 is false: dense $K_5$-free graphs without linear triangle-free sets

nodes.summary: The conjecture states that for every real $\delta > 0$ there is a real $c > 0$ such that, for all sufficiently large $n$, every $K_5$-free simple graph on $n$ vertices with at least $\delta n^2$ edges has a triangle-free set of at least $c n$ vertices (a set of vertices no three of which are pairwise adjacent).
nodes.title: EP-533: linear triangle-free sets in dense $K_5$-free graphs

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ and every real $\varepsilon > 0$, the empty graph on $n$ vertices has no four pairwise adjacent vertices, and its number of edges (namely $0$) is at most $(1/8 + \varepsilon) n^2$.
nodes.title: The empty graph meets the Ramsey–Turán edge bound for $K_4$
